EL PASO, TX- A 17-year-old human smuggler just learned the hard way that there are consequences when you break the law. He was convicted of alien smuggling resulting in death and handed a sentence of 24 months in jail, plus supervised release until he turns 21.

These charges come from a fatal smuggling attempt where he smuggled nine people through a storm drain- one of them never made it out alive.

Let this be a reminder- human smugglers don't care about human life. The journey to illegally enter the U.S. is deadly. Don't risk it.

@USBPChiefEPT
